relation.instructions: How are these two changes related?

criteria.caller update: one change updates a caller or user of what the other change defines or changes
criteria.same intent: both changes serve the same purpose or feature
criteria.same pattern: both apply the same mechanical edit (rename, signature tweak, repeated pattern)
criteria.test for: one change is a test that exercises the other change
criteria.unrelated: the changes have nothing to do with each other
